##### Project general facts

Ellington Views is a refined residential development designed to offer a serene coastal and golf-facing lifestyle, set between the lush fairways of Al Hamra Golf Course and the vibrant Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, with views extending towards Marjan Island and the Arabian Gulf. The architecture emphasizes openness and connection to nature, with expansive glazing and thoughtfully positioned residences that maximize panoramic views of the sea, marina, and greenery. The overall design creates a calm and elevated living environment where every home is framed by natural beauty.

The development offers a welcoming arrival experience defined by landscaped surroundings, swaying palm trees, and carefully curated greenery that creates a sense of calm and exclusivity from the moment of entry. The drop-off area is designed to evoke a resort-like atmosphere, setting the tone for a premium residential experience. Residents benefit from a range of lifestyle amenities that support relaxation, wellbeing, and social interaction within a peaceful, nature-inspired setting.

The interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials, featuring elevated ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows that enhance natural light and highlight the surrounding views. Bedrooms are designed as private retreats with access to balconies, while bathrooms offer a refined spa-like atmosphere with premium fixtures. The kitchens are fitted with custom-designed cabinetry, sintered stone countertops, and high-quality European appliances. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to personalize their homes according to their own lifestyle and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jazeera is a vibrant and growing community nestled in the heart of Ras Al Khaimah, one of the seven emirates that make up the United Arab Emirates. This charming neighborhood offers residents a unique blend of modern convenience, natural beauty, and a sense of community. Al Jazeera benefits from its strategic location within Ras Al Khaimah, providing easy access to major roadways and amenities. Residents can quickly reach the city center, shopping malls, schools, and healthcare facilities.

Al Jazeera embraces green spaces and parks, creating a harmonious environment where residents can enjoy the outdoors, relax, and engage in various recreational activities. This commitment to greenery adds to the neighborhood's overall quality of life. It is more than just a residential area; it fosters a strong sense of community. Residents often come together for various social and cultural events, creating a friendly and welcoming atmosphere.

The community features a range of retail outlets, supermarkets, and other essential amenities, ensuring that residents have easy access to everything they need within close proximity.
